\begin{align*}
(75+117i)z+\frac{96+144i}{z} &= (75+117i)(4(\cos \theta + i \sin \theta)) + \frac{96+144i}{4(\cos \theta + i \sin \theta)}\\
&= (75+117i)(4\cos \theta + 4i\sin \theta) + \frac{1}{4}(96+144i)(\cos \theta - i\sin \theta)\\
&= 300\cos \theta + 468i\sin \theta + 24\cos \theta + 36i\sin \theta + 24\cos \theta - 36i\sin \theta\\
&= 348\cos \theta + 468i\sin \theta
\end{align*}

Now, we can find the real part of this expression, which is $348\cos \theta$.

To maximize the real part, we need to maximize the value of $\cos \theta$. The maximum value of $\cos \theta$ is 1, which occurs when $\theta = 0$.

Therefore, the largest possible real part of the expression is $348\cdot 1 = 348$.
